chapter.title: Chapter 4
paragraphs: Some years ago—never mind how long precisely—having little or no money in my purse.
Nothing particular to interest me on shore.
I thought I would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world.

memo.core_thesis: Moby-Dick's famous opening line and the narrator's self-introduction.

comments.content: One of the most quoted openings in English — the narrator's self-naming is also a withdrawal from full identity.
